g.text: Monthly operating cost: a simple CRUD app plus authentication
1,000 API requests/active user/month; 90% reads; 100 kB app data/account; 1% app/policy diagnostics. Nathan adds live policy checks.
28 Oct 2026 prices; USD before tax. Totals exclude labor, development and unspecified external services. 1M+ capacity is unverified.
